$comment: Status of every dataset. See ACCESS.md. open = explore freely; sealed = one spend, question declared first; spent = report only, never feedback.

datasets/splits2/dev-*.jsonl.note: The development split, and the only place exploration belongs. 34 branch_mining, 15 direct_xray, 14 humanized_xray, 14 detour_xray and 19 throttled_xray, so all four evasion styles can be tuned against without spending anything.

history.change: created from the first 77 bot sessions
19 throttled_xray recorded straight into the open pool, because the only throttled sessions in the corpus were spent and question tuning needs data it is allowed to be influenced by

datasets/features/all2.jsonl.note: Superset that includes the holdout sessions. Reading it for anything other than a whole-corpus description re-reads spent data; prefer the dev split.

uses.question: Does the shipped policy beat classic heuristics at a matched false-positive ceiling?
uses.outcome: No advantage; 3 vs 3 discordant, p = 1.0. docs/benchmark.md

uses.question: Does session-wide ore counting catch a ratio-throttled cheat?
uses.outcome: 0 of 15 at any threshold under the ceiling. docs/evasion.md

uses.question: Does the language model add anything over a feature-only rule?
uses.outcome: Confounded on this set; the matched comparison used the confirmation set instead. scripts/ablation-llm.mjs

uses.question: EXPLORATORY, should have used dev: raw traces vs summarised features on detour.
EXPLORATORY, should have used dev: threshold-free categorical answer, and evidence-sufficiency routing.
uses.outcome: 46% false positives; routing does not fire.

uses.question: Does reviewApproachTargetingAlone = 0.35 hold on sessions recorded after it was frozen?
uses.outcome: 9 of 10 caught at 1 of 12 false positives, against 3 of 10 without the rule. The use it was recorded for.

uses.question: Matched ablation: feature-only rule fitted on the same 134 sessions, measured here.
uses.outcome: Identical to the policy, 9/10, zero discordant pairs.

uses.question: EXPLORATORY, should have used dev: threshold-free categorical answer.
EXPLORATORY, should have used dev: escalating-evidence loop.
uses.outcome: 4/10 recall at 4/12 false positives; escalation fires but the model is fooled at stage 2.

datasets/labels/sealed1.jsonl.note: Bot sessions recorded after the grid search stopped: 40 legit-branch-mining and 20 each of xray-direct, xray-detour, xray-humanized and xray-throttled, seed 91, start index 2000, world arena2. To be spent once by scripts/confirm-frozen.mjs on the question written at the top of that file. Session counts are as requested from the recorder; runs that fail to produce telemetry will make the labelled count smaller.
